node.statement: Assume the complete package asserted in the preceding child as hypotheses: J,{e_j},P_j,R,t have the displayed meanings; A is extended t-C*, P_j and R are t-projections, ||R-I_A|| <= W.c0_cb*epsilon <= t, all P_j are one-dimensional, and ~ is an equivalence relation with class family C. Then there exist B=oplus_{C in C} M_{|C|} and an extended W.c0_cb*W.K_call*epsilon-isomorphism v:B->A satisfying ||v(I_B)-I_A|| <= W.c0_cb*W.K_call*epsilon.
